notes:
NAME COLLISION - HANDLED EXPLICITLY, AS INSTRUCTED. This dataset contains a SECOND, DIFFERENT doctor of essentially the same name: 'Dr A Mohan Krishna' (row 246), an ORTHOPAEDICIAN at Apollo Jubilee Hills. The two are provably distinct people, and I found the proof: Apollo 24|7 carries pages for the orthopaedician under three name variants but ONE shared UUID - https://www.apollo247.com/doctors/dr-a-mohan-krishna-d042f48b-9b31-4fe0-8904-e0ebea025f03 , https://www.apollo247.com/doctors/dr-mohan-krishna-althuri-d042f48b-9b31-4fe0-8904-e0ebea025f03 (surname ALTHURI, hence the 'A') and a further orthopaedician page https://www.apollo247.com/doctors/dr-mohan-krishna-a-e1fc612e-8f72-4946-8fd1-41974d1ff311 - all labelled 'Orthopaedician'. NONE of them is this row's doctor. Accordingly I recorded NOTHING from apollo247 for row 242 and deliberately left directory_profile blank rather than attach an orthopaedic page to a plastic surgeon; no Apollo 24|7 URL appears anywhere in this record. Everything recorded here is sourced to pages that state PLASTIC/COSMETIC surgery AND Secunderabad. The independent distinguishing signal for this row's man is the initial 'D': Skedoc lists him as 'Dr.D. Mohan Krishna, Plastic surgeon', versus 'A.' / 'Althuri' for the orthopaedician. A human should still keep the two rows apart deliberately.

IDENTITY EVIDENCE: askapollo.com (Apollo's official appointment domain) result title is 'Dr Mohan Krishna | Plastic Surgeon in Hyderabad - Apollo Hospitals Secunderabad' - name + specialty + exact unit in one string, which is the strongest single line of evidence. apollohospitals.com carries two official pages for him ('Dr. Mohan Krishna - Best Plastic Surgeon in Hyderabad' and the corporate plastic-surgeon listing). Non-official corroboration independently places the same plastic surgeon at Apollo Secunderabad: HexaHealth (Secunderabad, plastic & reconstructive surgeon), Vaidam (cosmetic surgeon, Secunderabad), Medsurge India (cosmetic surgeon, Secunderabad), Shifa India ('Consultant | Apollo Hospital, Secunderabad'), and a JustDial venue listing 'Dr. Mohan Krishna (Apollo Hospital), Gopalapuram-Secunderabad, near Keys High School, beside Sangeet Theatre' (venue signal only - no JustDial number was taken, they are call-tracking proxies).

WHY MEDIUM AND NOT HIGH: every OFFICIAL source here belongs to the Apollo organisation itself (apollohospitals.com plus Apollo's own askapollo.com booking domain). Per the brief, several pages on one hospital's own web estate do not add up to two independent official sources, and unlike the other rows in this batch there is no Apollo 24|7 page for this doctor to serve as a second official property. One targeted query for a government or medical-council listing (healinindia.gov.in / NMC / Telangana State Medical Council) returned nothing official for him. So the band reflects source independence, not doubt about who he is - the Secunderabad + plastic-surgery match itself is solid.

PHONE DELIBERATELY NOT RECORDED: a summary offered 04069321004 as 'Apollo Hospitals Secunderabad phone'. An exact-phrase re-search of that string (run for row 241, same number) returned it templated across many unrelated Apollo Hyderabad doctor and department pages, proving it is Apollo's generic Hyderabad appointment line, not a Secunderabad-specific or doctor-specific line. The brief forbids recording a hospital's central booking line as the doctor's, so professional_phone is blank; the hospital-level fallback covers the switchboard.

No email, LinkedIn, personal website, clinic website URL, ORCID, Google Scholar, ResearchGate or professional social account surfaced in any query, so those are blank rather than guessed - notable given that plastic/cosmetic surgeons often do have practice Instagram or YouTube accounts; I found none that tied to him, and I did not attach any name-match-only account. owns_clinic left FALSE even though search text describes a 'Dr. D. Mohan Krishna Clinic' at Thrimurthy Colony, Mahendra Hills, East Marredpally, Secunderabad - that came from aggregator text with no clinic website and no official confirmation of ownership; worth a human check, and if confirmed it would be the best direct route to him.

OTHER ITEMS FOR HUMAN REVIEW: (a) EXPERIENCE is badly inconsistent - Apollo-derived text says 16+ years (agreeing with the input row) while other profiles say 30 or 45 years with MBBS in 1980; the input row's '16+' is satisfied either way but the true figure is unresolved; (b) one aggregator reports a Hyderabad Medical Council registration number (8727) - NOT recorded as a verified fact, since it appeared only in aggregator text and could not be checked against a council register; (c) one summary said 'Apollo Hospital, Shivaji Nagar' rather than Gopalapuram - both are Secunderabad locality descriptors for the Apollo Secunderabad campus, but the discrepancy is noted.
